name: Druva - Unusual Data Activity Followed by Quarantine
description: Correlates unusual data activity with subsequent quarantine of the same protected resource.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL resource = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name)
  )

| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(druva.alert.name),
      TO_STRING(druva.event_type),
      ""
    )
  )

| EVAL is_uda =
    druva.uda.type IS NOT NULL
    OR event_text LIKE "*unusual data activity*"
    OR event_text LIKE "*data anomaly*"

| EVAL is_quarantine =
    event_text LIKE "*quarantine*"
    OR druva.event_type == "Added To Quarantine Bay"

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| WHERE resource IS NOT NULL
    AND (is_uda OR is_quarantine)

| STATS
    uda_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE is_uda,

    quarantine_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE is_quarantine,

    first_uda =
      MIN(event_time) WHERE is_uda,

    first_quarantine =
      MIN(event_time) WHERE is_quarantine,

    uda_types =
      VALUES(
        TO_STRING(druva.uda.type)
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    alert_names =
      VALUES(
        TO_STRING(druva.alert.name)
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    quarantine_actions =
      VALUES(druva.event_type)
        WHERE is_quarantine,

    uda_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    quarantine_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ) WHERE is_quarantine

  BY resource

| WHERE uda_count > 0
    AND quarantine_count > 0
    AND first_quarantine >= first_uda

| EVAL minutes_to_quarantine =
    DATE_DIFF(
      "minutes",
      first_uda,
      first_quarantine
    )

name: Druva - Administrator Impossible Travel
description: Detects the same Druva administrator successfully authenticating from two or more countries within 60 minutes, which may indicate impossible travel or compromised credentials.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.feature == "Admin Event"
    AND druva.event_type == "Admin Login"
    AND event.outcome == "success"
    AND user.email IS NOT NULL
    AND source.ip IS NOT NULL
    AND source.geo.country_iso_code IS NOT NULL

| STATS
    country_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(source.geo.country_iso_code),
    countries = VALUES(source.geo.country_iso_code),
    ip_addresses = VALUES(source.ip),
    first_login = MIN(@timestamp),
    last_login = MAX(@timestamp)
  BY user.email

| WHERE country_count >= 2

| EVAL elapsed_minutes = DATE_DIFF("minutes", first_login, last_login)

| WHERE elapsed_minutes <= 60

name: Druva - Mass Backup Failures
description: Detects a high concentration of backup failures affecting the same resource during a short interval.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL resource = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(user.name)
  )

| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(druva.event_type),
      ""
    )
  )

| EVAL status = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(event.outcome),
      TO_STRING(event.outcome),
      ""
    )
  )

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| WHERE
    event_text LIKE "*backup failed*"
    OR (
      event_text LIKE "*backup*"
      AND (
        status LIKE "*fail*"
        OR status LIKE "*error*"
      )
    )

| STATS
    failure_count =
      COUNT(*),

    event_types =
      VALUES(druva.event_type),

    failure_states =
      VALUES(status),

    first_failure =
      MIN(event_time),

    last_failure =
      MAX(event_time),

    first_failure_type =
      FIRST(druva.event_type, event_time),

    latest_failure_type =
      LAST(druva.event_type, event_time),

    first_failure_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ),

    latest_failure_details =
      LAST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      )

  BY resource

| WHERE failure_count >= 20

name: Druva - Short-Lived Administrator Account
description: Detects an administrator account that is created and subsequently deleted within 24 hours. Highlights potentially temporary or covert privileged access.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.event_type == "Administrator Created"
    OR druva.event_type == "Administrator Deleted"

| EVAL target_admin =
    TO_STRING(user.email)

| EVAL actor =
    TO_STRING(user.id)

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| EVAL action = CASE(
    druva.event_type == "Administrator Created", "created",
    druva.event_type == "Administrator Deleted", "deleted",
    "other"
  )

| WHERE target_admin IS NOT NULL
    AND action != "other"

| STATS
    created_at =
      MIN(event_time) WHERE action == "created",

    deleted_at =
      MIN(event_time) WHERE action == "deleted",

    created_by =
      VALUES(actor) WHERE action == "created",

    deleted_by =
      VALUES(actor) WHERE action == "deleted",

    creation_results =
      VALUES(TO_STRING(event.outcome))
        WHERE action == "created",

    deletion_results =
      VALUES(TO_STRING(event.outcome))
        WHERE action == "deleted",

    creation_event_types =
      VALUES(druva.event_type)
        WHERE action == "created",

    deletion_event_types =
      VALUES(druva.event_type)
        WHERE action == "deleted",

    creation_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE action == "created",

    deletion_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE action == "deleted"

  BY target_admin

| WHERE creation_count > 0
    AND deletion_count > 0
    AND deleted_at >= created_at

| EVAL lifetime_minutes =
    DATE_DIFF(
      "minutes",
      created_at,
      deleted_at
    )

| WHERE lifetime_minutes <= 1440

name: Druva - UDA Correlated With Backup Disablement
description: Detects unusual data activity combined with backup disablement or pause for the same resource, indicating a potentially serious attempt to compromise data and recovery simultaneously.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL resource = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.profile.name)
  )

| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(druva.alert.name),
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(druva.event_type),
      ""
    )
  )

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| EVAL actor = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(user.id),
    TO_STRING(user.name)
  )

| EVAL is_uda =
    druva.uda.type IS NOT NULL
    OR event_text LIKE "*unusual data activity*"

| EVAL is_backup_disabled =
    event_text LIKE "*backup*disabled*"
    OR event_text LIKE "*disabled*backup*"
    OR event_text LIKE "*backup*paused*"
    OR event_text LIKE "*paused*backup*"

| WHERE resource IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      is_uda
      OR is_backup_disabled
    )

| STATS
    uda_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE is_uda,

    disable_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE is_backup_disabled,

    first_uda =
      MIN(event_time) WHERE is_uda,

    first_disable =
      MIN(event_time)
        WHERE is_backup_disabled,

    uda_types =
      VALUES(
        TO_STRING(druva.uda.type)
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    uda_alert_names =
      VALUES(
        TO_STRING(druva.alert.name)
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    disable_event_types =
      VALUES(druva.event_type)
        WHERE is_backup_disabled,

    disable_actors =
      VALUES(actor)
        WHERE is_backup_disabled,

    uda_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    disable_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ) WHERE is_backup_disabled

  BY resource

| WHERE uda_count > 0
    AND disable_count > 0

| EVAL minutes_between =
    DATE_DIFF(
      "minutes",
      first_uda,
      first_disable
    )

author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL resource = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(user.name)
  )

| EVAL status_text = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(event.outcome),
      TO_STRING(event.outcome),
      ""
    )
  )

| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(druva.alert.name),
      TO_STRING(druva.event_type),
      ""
    )
  )

| EVAL feature_text =
    TO_LOWER(
      COALESCE(
        TO_STRING(druva.feature),
        ""
      )
    )

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| EVAL is_uda =
    druva.uda.type IS NOT NULL
    OR event_text LIKE "*unusual data activity*"

| EVAL is_backup_failure =
    (
      event_text LIKE "*backup*"
      OR feature_text LIKE "*backup*"
    )
    AND (
      status_text LIKE "*fail*"
      OR status_text LIKE "*error*"
      OR event_text LIKE "*failed*"

| WHERE resource IS NOT NULL

| STATS
    uda_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE is_uda,

    backup_failure_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE is_backup_failure,

    first_uda =
      MIN(event_time) WHERE is_uda,

    first_backup_failure =
      MIN(event_time)

    uda_types =

        TO_STRING(druva.uda.type)
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    uda_alert_names =
      VALUES(
        TO_STRING(druva.alert.name)
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    backup_failure_types =
      VALUES(druva.event_type)

    first_uda_details =

      ) WHERE is_uda,

    first_failure_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ) WHERE is_backup_failure

  BY resource

| WHERE uda_count > 0
    AND backup_failure_count > 0

| EVAL minutes_between =
    DATE_DIFF(
      "minutes",
      first_uda,
      first_backup_failure
    )
